key_decisions.rationale: Preserves active search, disciples, duration, Spirit-mediated warning, repetition, and destination.
key_decisions.before: We found the disciples there and stayed seven days. Through the Spirit they kept telling Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
key_decisions.after: We sought out the disciples and stayed there seven days. Through the Spirit they kept telling Paul not to set foot in Jerusalem.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And having found the disciples, we stayed there seven days, and through the Spirit they were telling Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.

key_decisions.after: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps enacted sign, body parts, divine speech, location, binding, owner, and transfer; “leaders” avoids collective blame while retaining identity.
key_decisions.before: He came to us, took Paul’s belt, bound his own feet and hands, and said, “This is what the Holy Spirit says: ‘In this way the Jewish people in Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’”
key_decisions.after: He came to us, took Paul's belt, bound his own feet and hands, and said, “This is what the Holy Spirit says: ‘In this way the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt and hand him over to Gentiles.’”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and coming to us, he took Paul’s belt and bound his own feet and hands and said, “Thus says the Holy Spirit: ‘So will the Jews in Jerusalem bind the man to whom this belt belongs and deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the earlier decision, Gentile believers, and all four requirements present in the pinned text.
key_decisions.before: As for the Gentiles who have trusted, we sent them our decision that they should keep away from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from what has been strangled, and from sexual immorality.”
key_decisions.after: As for the Gentiles who have believed, we sent them our decision that they should keep away from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from what is strangled, and from sexual immorality.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But concerning the Gentiles who have believed, we sent a letter, having decided that they should keep themselves from what has been sacrificed to idols and from blood and from what has been strangled and from sexual immorality.”
